facingNote: Mixed by design: the butterfly is a top view facing UP (rotate to heading); the tadpole is a side view facing RIGHT (flip horizontally).

butterfly.notes: Top view facing up. Body, head, eyes and antennae are mirror-symmetric about x=6.5 and byte-identical in all four frames; the wing rims are deliberately asymmetric for the upper-right key light: the right wing's lit top/outer edges are unrimmed so butterfly-cream meets the background on the forewing and orange meets it on the hindwing, while the shadow-side left wing keeps the full ink rim (outline coverage 0.65, was 0.84). Thin ink body on columns 6-7 from the head (row 2) to the abdomen tip (row 8); two 2px antennae with clubs at rows 0-1; cream eye highlights at (5,2)/(8,2). Orange wings with a butterfly-cream crescent inside each forewing and a poppy-shade eyespot with a butterfly-cream centre on each hindwing. Wing spans 12 / 10 / 8 / 10 px make the open-close beat unmistakable. The antennae deliberately reach the top cell row (thin line art, not a clipped silhouette); there is 1px transparent padding left, right and below. No baked shadow.

tadpole.notes: Side view facing right. Green-teal head (leaf-mid) on x3-5 / y1-3 with a leaf-dark jaw shadow, a warm cream eye at (4,2) and a cream rim light on the lit top-right shoulder (5,1), so it reads against any pond tone instead of vanishing; the tail root is leaf-mid, fading to translucent water-mid and water-light toward the tip. The fin sweeps down / level / up / level-low; the head pixels are byte-identical in every frame, so the body centre never drifts. Tail trails to x0 (flip for leftward swims). 5 opaque colours. No baked shadow; it swims inside the water layer.
